reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the intervention (0.5 at.% W addition) and its mechanism (lattice distortion, intermetallic formation, oxide glaze) from P7/P15, which already demonstrated improved high-temperature wear resistance for AlCoCrFeNiWx coatings at 800 °C, to a CoCrFeNi matrix. The extension to a full temperature range from RT to 800 °C is a minor variation, and the mechanism is stated almost verbatim from the earlier work. The core idea is therefore a restatement of a known result as a prediction for a slightly different alloy base.
copied_elements: W addition to a CoCrFeNi-based HEA to improve high-temperature wear resistance
W-induced lattice distortion and W-rich intermetallic phases as strengthening mechanism
formation of a protective oxide glaze at high temperature
reduction in friction coefficient and wear loss compared to unmodified alloy
